item.title: KNEC Issues Way Forward for Kenyans Who Wish to Repeat KCSE Exams
item.description: Candidates who failed specific subjects have also been invited to take advantage of the window for a resit before the end-of-month deadline.

item.title: State House Seeks Ksh20 Billion Budget Amid Uproar
item.description: State House is among the places where Kenyans perceive there are government excesses despite calls from President Ruto for austerity in his government.

item.title: Sifuna Alleges Ksh2 Billion Bribe Plot as Linda Mwananchi Faces Digital Blockade
item.description: Sifuna rubbished claims that he has been demanding an offer from the government to drop the Linda Mwananchi tours and support the broad-based deal.

item.title: Motorists Stuck for Hours as Heavy Rains Paralyze Roads, NTSA Issues Advisory
item.description: The weatherman predicts that the above-normal rainfall experienced across the country will likely continue till April, with Kenyans being urged to brace themselves for these changes.

item.title: KURA Announces 15-Day Traffic Disruption on Busy Nairobi Road
item.description: KURA noted that police officers and traffic marshals would be deployed along the busy road to help manage traffic and ensure smooth movement.

item.title: KDF and Red Cross Deploy as Heavy Rains Submerge CBD and Major Highways
item.description: Kenya Met has indicated heavy rainfall of up to 20 mm between Wednesday and Monday next week, especially in Nairobi and other regions in the country as the long rain season begins.

item.title: Governor Orders Immediate Removal of All Structures on Road Reserves
item.description: The planned exercise is part of broader efforts by the county to enforce planning regulations, reclaim public spaces, and improve infrastructure.

item.title: Monica Juma Appointed to Third Highest Post at UN
item.description: Monica Juma is among the faces that have remained at President Ruto's side from the previous government and has been involved in many security decisions.

item.title: Govt Begins New Talks With World Bank Over 750KM Highway Project
item.description: The 750-kilometre road project is considered the longest road infrastructure project undertaken in the country since independence, costing nearly Ksh100 billion.

item.title: CS Ruku Orders Immediate Changes, Calls Emergency Meeting After Nairobi Floods
item.description: Residents of Nairobi were forced to spend hours in traffic, while others were rescued as the rains caused heavy flooding in Nairobi on Friday night.
